summary: Comprehensive testing of location-based salary pSEO system with cost tier classification engine. All 14 features tested successfully. Location salary pages render with unique city-aware content including intros, explanations, FAQs, purchasing power summaries, and comparison paragraphs based on city cost tier, tax profile, and purchasing power band.

Test 2: Location salary page /guides/30000-salary-in-new-york renders with correct title, COL index 187, purchasing power $16,043, NY state tax 6.9%, rent 182% of take-home
Test 3: Location salary page /guides/30000-salary-in-austin renders with different content - COL index 103, purchasing power $29,126, no state tax ($0), rent 71% of take-home
Test 4: Location salary page /guides/80000-salary-in-san-francisco renders with very-high cost tier content - COL index 179, CA state tax 7.2%, rent 69% of take-home
Test 5: Location salary page /guides/100000-salary-in-austin renders with moderate cost, no-tax content - 'moderate costs' and 'zero state income tax' present
Test 6: Location salary page /guides/100000-salary-in-new-york renders with very-high cost, state-tax content - 'extreme cost of living' and 'NY's 6.9% state tax' present
Test 7: Location salary page /guides/200000-salary-in-seattle renders correctly with WA no-tax advantage, COL index 156
Test 8: Location salary page /guides/300000-salary-in-portland renders correctly with OR 9.0% state tax, COL index 130
Test 9: Each page has 'Purchasing Power' section present (verified on all location salary pages)
Test 10: Each page has 6 FAQs that are city-specific - Austin FAQs mention 'Austin' 13 times, NYC FAQs mention 'New York' 12 times
Test 11: Same salary ($100K) in Austin vs NYC produce different intro text - Austin: 'moderate costs', NYC: 'extreme cost of living'
Test 12: Homepage / loads correctly with RealProfits branding
Test 13: Guides hub /guides loads with 703+ guide categories
Test 14: Other pSEO types still work: /guides/50000-salary (salary-guide-page), /guides/tax-on-100000-income (tax-guide-page)
test_credentials: No auth required - all pages are public
seed_data_creation: None required - all data is generated dynamically from datasets
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cost tier classification engine verified working. Key findings: (1) costTier.ts classifies cities into low/moderate/high/very-high tiers based on COL index and rent. (2) variationEngine.ts generates 72+ unique intros and explanations using 3 salary buckets × 4 cost tiers × 2 tax profiles. (3) FAQs are city-specific with 6 questions per page mentioning city name 10+ times. (4) Purchasing Power section shows adjusted salary based on COL index. (5) City comparison paragraphs reference contrasting cities. (6) Content differentiation verified: same $100K salary shows 'moderate costs' in Austin vs 'extreme cost of living' in NYC. (7) Tax profile correctly shows $0 state tax for TX/WA/FL states and actual rates for CA/NY/OR. (8) All data-testid attributes working: location-salary-guide-page, salary-guide-page, tax-guide-page, pseo-breadcrumb, pseo-direct-answer, pseo-compare-section.
